purpose: Learner-facing Family Members lesson copy in every canonical learn-from language. Target-language kinship facts remain structured and relationship-first so the same researched profile can be explained to any source-language learner without a 104 x 21 pair matrix.

compact_core_v1.description: Tier 3 core lesson uses the already-localized source bridge as its invitation/relationship-first explanation, then adds all remaining visible lesson copy locally. App-wide navigation buttons come from the normal interface localization pack; lesson-specific fallback buttons are included for learn-from languages that do not yet have a production UI pack.

review_policy: Machine-created localization can provide coverage but must stay labeled machine_translated until native/community review promotes it. Language availability and human verification are separate states.
